subject: fix(app): a new account's start date no longer shows a time zone
body:
A new account's start date is now midnight UTC, the same in every zone.

A unit test checks it in four zones.

subject: fix: deploys go green and the backlog is tidied (#65)
body:
Deploy run 36692304266 went red on check 4 because a third-party frame logged a
report-only policy warning. Nothing was blocked.

subject: fix(hq): the Decisions page is one table with one search
body:
A search on the page filtered only the table it sat above, so "gate"
left all 177 earlier lines showing. Every decision is now a row of one
dataTable: the files newest first, then the frozen lines in the file's
order, with a Part column ("From 2 Oct 2026", "To 2 Oct 2026") that
can also be filtered. The two headings and their notes move into the
page's info button and one line of counts.

On a 390 px phone the Text cell overflowed: as a card, a cell is a grid
of label and value, and each run of text and each <code> in it became
a grid cell, so code sat over the next words and the sentence was cut
mid-word. The cell's contents are now one span, and hq.css lets that
cell and its code wrap on a narrow screen. The CSS has no test; the
single span does.

subject: test: an item heard twice is held once
body:
A review of the move. The unit tests never applied the most common record,
so a typo in that branch would have passed them.
